The Zoom Room B hub replacement is ticket #4092. I've posted that as a reply to Dana's message in #north-team.

The number comes from Ilse in #north-random on Oct 13. She said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because it resets the Polycom. Dana is in that channel, so she can see the same message herself.

Dana's private guess about a future ticket number came to me in a DM, so I left it out of the channel reply.
